VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Nov. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Methanex Corporation (the “Company” or “Methanex”) (TSX: MX) (Nasdaq: MEOH) announced today that it has agreed to a renewed and extended revolving credit facility with its syndicate bank partners, increasing the size of the facility to US$500 million and establishing a new five-year maturity. The renewed facility includes updates to the covenant package to reflect the Company’s stronger financial position, ensuring additional financial flexibility through all points in the methanol price cycle.


The Company also announced that it has issued a notice of redemption for the remaining US$400 million of its outstanding 5.125% senior notes due October 15, 2027. The redemption date is December 29, 2026.


Dean Richardson, Senior Vice President, Finance and Chief Financial Officer, Methanex Corporation, stated, “Maintaining a strong balance sheet and ample financial flexibility are critical elements of our overall business strategy. We are pleased to finalize this extended and enhanced US$500 million revolving credit facility and to continue our deleveraging strategy with a US$400 million bond redemption.”


**ABOUT METHANEX**


Methanex is a Vancouver-based, publicly traded company and is the world’s largest supplier of methanol globally. Methanex shares are listed for trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange in Canada under the trading symbol “MX” and on the Nasdaq Stock Market in the United States under the trading symbol “MEOH”. Methanex can be visited online at[www.methanex.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=fXMgGq2-sgjNxL99LWBN7OdCOVH9uMYyHOTc5JPtobuweU6Vt-y2-Kz6990R9RFXP_qfQIqgN9WmiWFIGvwohwM5s250J31eb8WZ7RDDICU=) .
